title: Lika Val Handmade Ceramic Fish Wall Art
description: This little fish was born from clay, texture, color, and the desire to bring a small piece of the sea into the home. A small handmade ceramic shell above the fish completes the story, as if this little creature has just returned from the sea and brought a treasure with it. This is a one-of-a-kind handmade ceramic wall decoration, perfect for a coastal home, creative studio, nursery, beach-inspired interior, or anyone who loves unusual handmade art. No two handmade pieces are ever exactly alike — and this fish cannot be recreated in precisely the same way. A little piece of the sea, shaped by hand. And perhaps she already knows where she is going.
